The new key is invalid or not yet active, so this is a rotated/bad credential rather than a provider outage. The provider is responding quickly and only rejecting authentication. No deploy appears in the logs.

Another reading is that the mailer provider broke on its side and is rejecting auth. But the 401s start right after the local key rotation. The webhook-dispatcher 502s from customer hooks started at 05:02 and come from unrelated customer endpoints, so they look like a red herring.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll MAILER_API_KEY in the secrets store back to a working version, or make sure v6 is actually valid and activated with the mailer provider. Then reload template-svc. After that, check that /v3/send returns 2xx and the 502 rate on /v1/notify drops. Add a validation check to the secret rotation step so a new key is tested before the old one is revoked.
